claims.summary: Michaelis classifies embora as a conjunction meaning apesar de / ainda que.
The DLE classifies aunque as concessive and states that it introduces an ineffective impediment; it also records an adversative use equivalent to pero.
The two dictionary entries support the lexical meanings described here but do not provide evidence in these entries for mood selection or the previous conjugated examples.
